name: Potential Direct Syscall of NtOpenProcess
description: Detects potential calls to NtOpenProcess directly from NTDLL.
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.event_data.CallTrace:UNKNOWN* AND (NOT ((winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*vcredist_x64.exe AND process.executable:*vcredist_x64.exe) OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)) AND (winlog.event_data.TargetImage:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*))) OR winlog.provider_name:Microsoft\-Windows\-Kernel\-Audit\-API\-Calls)) AND (NOT ((winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\:\\Windows\\system32\\systeminfo.exe AND process.executable:*setup64.exe) OR (process.executable:*\:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Cylance\\Desktop\\CylanceUI.exe) OR (process.executable:*AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe) OR (process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft\ VS\ Code\\Code.exe AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft\ VS\ Code\\Code.exe) OR (winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\current\\Teams.exe AND process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\current\\Teams.exe) OR (winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\AppData\\Local\\Discord\\* AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\Discord.exe) OR (process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\yammerdesktop\\app\-* AND process.executable:*\\Yammer.exe AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\AppData\\Local\\yammerdesktop\\app\-* AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\Yammer.exe AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x1000) OR winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\Evernote\\Evernote.exe OR (process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Adobe\\Acrobat\ DC\\Acrobat\\* AND process.executable:*\\AcroCEF.exe AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Adobe\\Acrobat\ DC\\Acrobat\\* AND winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\AcroCEF.exe)))
